title: Privometry detector pack set v1
description: Privometry's detector packs released together, so detectors change without a binary release: DSSE payloadType application/vnd.privometry.detectorpacks+json, signed with the release key. Each pack is its pack.yaml manifest and the documents of its detectors/ folder, as JSON. Devices reject a set_version not higher than the one they hold or the one built into them, keep their built-in pack for any pack whose min_sensor_version is above their own version, and reject the whole set if any detector's samples fail.

detectors.description: The files of the pack's detectors/ folder, in file name order.
